sql: SELECT sku, channel, SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-08' THEN revenue_ngn ELSE 0 END) AS target, SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-07' THEN revenue_ngn ELSE 0 END) AS baseline FROM kola.erp_sales WHERE city = 'Lagos' AND sku IN ('PLNT-150') AND month IN ('2026-07', '2026-08') GROUP BY sku, channel ORDER BY sku, channel
